notes: Company snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS (product/support search module they sell as a feature).
Primary goal: replace brittle heuristic ranker with ML reranker to lift top-3 CTR and reduce manual curation.
Starting path: trial Hosted API for quick experiments -> Dedicated for predictable throughput/data isolation if POC successful.
Technical constraints: offline bulk scoring of ~500k candidates/week, want efficient batching/quantization recommendations to keep cost <= $X/token estimate.
Latency targets: live rerank endpoint needs p50 ~ 80-120ms for single-request rerank (re-ranking 10 candidates), but offline scoring throughput more important for nightly recompute.
Data/security: must pass SOC2 controls, SSO/SAML for Console access, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS for key management, potential EU residency for subset of customer data.
Quote from VP Product (call): "If we can get a predictable per-score cost and keep median latency under 120ms for small rerank calls, we can justify Dedicated."

Evaluation metrics: NDCG@5 uplift vs baseline, precision@1, impact on support RTT and deflection rate. Also monitoring for hallucination in explanations returned by model when asked to justify rerank choices.
POC plan: run two arms — (A) Hosted API end-to-end rerank on 25k eval pairs; (B) bulk offline scoring via Dedicated-like throughput to estimate monthly cost and runtime for nightly recompute.
Engineering notes: Priya (lead eng) prefers Python SDK, asked about KV-cache reuse for repeated queries and prefix caching to reduce tokens billed.
Sales/finance: procurement wants pricing tie-out for 12-month ARR band, requesting committed throughput options with burst buffer and SLA language.
use_case_summary: Product team wants a reranking endpoint to re-score retrieved candidate documents (top-K) for support search and contextual recommendations. They need offline scoring to recompute embeddings/rerank scores nightly and a low-latency live endpoint for user-facing scenarios. Cost predictability and model/version rollouts are critical.
integration_notes: Will ingest current retrieval candidates (IDs + contexts). Backend will send compact context + metadata; expect batching sizes of 8-32 for live calls, and large batched jobs (2k-50k) for offline. Initial POC uses existing annotated 25k eval pairs. Team uses Python, Airflow for nightly jobs.
poc_success_criteria: NDCG@5 uplift >= 10% vs current heuristic on held-out eval; live p50 latency <=120ms for 10-candidate rerank; estimated monthly compute cost within forecasted ARR band.
pricing_notes: Requested committed capacity quote for Dedicated (monthly) and per-unit cost for bulk offline scoring. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce cost via quantization and batching. Finance asked for tiered discounting at $100k+ ARR.
sales_playbook_notes: Mid-market play: start with free Hosted API credits for A/B experiments, progress to a focused rerank POC, then present Dedicated reserved capacity with burst for production. Emphasize observability and rollouts to mitigate quality/regression risk.
